title: Cyberwave Aerial Velocity Command
description: Canonical body-frame velocity command consumed by drone simulation and edge flight adapters.

linear_x.description: Forward velocity in meters per second in the aircraft body frame.

linear_y.description: Lateral velocity in meters per second in the aircraft body frame.

linear_z.description: Vertical velocity in meters per second, positive upward.

angular_z.description: Yaw velocity in radians per second.

duration_ms.description: Requested command hold duration. A value of 0 represents an immediate stop command.
